text: Good morning everyone, let us start the Atlas steering call.
Good morning. Laura sent her Agentar today, so we will hear the status from it.
Yes, thank you. That matches the status I have. One thing first, someone has to send the training invitations.
I can send the training invitations to the Trento group by Friday 13 November.
Good, thank you Sara. Please copy me.
Can Lyon confirm the date they sign the data processing agreement?
I spoke with Pierre Duval from Lyon yesterday. They will sign the agreement on 20 November.
That is good news, it keeps the January start for Lyon possible.
Agreed. I will ask Pierre to confirm the signing date in writing and send it to the group.
Who will run the user training at the Bonn site?
Katrin Vogel will run the training at Bonn. She starts on 2 December.
Right, Katrin Vogel from the Bonn team. Thank you.
Agentar, when does Atlas go live?
Agentar, can we move 5,000 euros to Lyon?
I do not have access to the Bonn dry run room. Laura should book the room for the dry run.
Good point, I will note that for Laura. Anything else from anyone?
No, that is all from me.
Thank you all, we close here.
